text.tspan: The bench shall bind the configured bicycle trajectory, geometry, timing, and exact bench identity: crossing speed 4.0 m/s, a closed observation window of 2.0 s, and map-frame source observations no older than 0.5 s.
The bench shall reconstruct ego and bicycle footprints independently from retained map-frame observations and reject missing or contradictory samples.
The bench shall hash-bind scenario, runtime, evaluator, observation, map-runtime, and artifact identities for independent replay.
Reviewer question: What physical hardware, software, and mechanical
elements make up the candidate system, and in which internal roles
Evidence-based assurance claims and their supporting argumentation.
Reviewers need claims, arguments, evidence, and gaps linked
in an assurance argument for the increment.
